purpose: The genuinely reachable NO_VALID_SECOND_ANCHOR: a DOUBLE TOP at the ATH. A later bar high (t=15) ties HA exactly, so it is excluded from candidacy by §6 (HB < HA strictly) but still belongs to the domination set of §8 (every bar high). Every descending line from A therefore passes below it and is pierced far beyond eps, leaving 24 candidates and 0 envelope-valid ones -> no line. Replaces the stale 'monotonic decline / no qualifying pivot' trigger that HD-11 made unreachable (see GX-08).
category: invalidation (no envelope-valid second anchor — duplicate ATH / double top)

expected_second_anchor.reason: No envelope-valid second anchor exists. Candidacy is over every later bar high (§6): 24 candidates (t=1..25, excluding t=15 whose high TIES HA and so fails the strict HB < HA test). Every candidate line descends from A, so it passes below the tying high at t=15 by exactly -15*m; the shallowest candidate (t=16, H=116) gives a pierce of 0.106823 log units = 5.34x eps=0.02. All 24 candidates are pierced -> NO_VALID_SECOND_ANCHOR (an explicit 'no signal' state, not an error, §10.4). NOT because any pivot is missing — pivot status is irrelevant to candidacy (§5, §6, D-TL-03, HD-11).

rejection_rationale.numeric: H[15]=130.00 = HA=130.00 -> HB < HA is false; implied slope m=(ln130-ln130)/15=0 (not < 0) -> not eligible (§6.2/§6.3).

key_inequalities: Candidacy (§6): every later bar high with HB < HA strictly -> t=1..25 minus t=15 = 24 candidates. NOT a pivot-restricted subset; pivot status is irrelevant (§5, §6, D-TL-03, HD-11).

Domination (§8 step 3, D-TL-05): the test runs over EVERY bar high, both intervening (tA < t_i < tB) and later (t_i > tB) — so the tying high at t=15 is tested against every candidate, whether it lies before or after that candidate.
Closed form: y[15] = yA exactly, so for any candidate with slope m the gap at t=15 is y[15]-y_hat(15) = yA-(yA+15m) = -15m = 15|m|. Validity therefore requires 15|m| <= eps, i.e. |m| <= 0.00133333.

Shallowest candidate: t=16 (H=116), m=(4.753590-4.867534)/16=-0.00712152. 15|m| = 0.106823 > eps = 0.02 (5.34x). Every other candidate is steeper, so 0 of 24 candidates are envelope-valid -> NO_VALID_SECOND_ANCHOR, no geometry (§10.4, §18).

eps-dependence (explicit, as in GX-12): the outcome is a TOLERANCE result, not a structural impossibility. It flips only for eps >= 0.106823. Re-checked at eps=0.05 (0.106823 > 0.05 -> still none) and eps=0.08 (0.106823 > 0.08 -> still none). Contrast GX-12, where the duplicate ATH sits 2 bars from A and its gap 0.012913 <= eps=0.02 is tolerated, so a line survives there; the geometry is identical in kind, only the lever arm (15 bars vs 2) differs.
No RESET_NEW_ATH: §10.3/§17 require a later high that EXCEEDS HA; H[15]=130 equals it (§18 Equal ATHs -> earliest anchor retained).
No ENVELOPE_TIE_LATER: the tie rule applies only among envelope-valid candidates; there are none.

Guards silent: max |y[t]-y[t-1]| = |ln130-ln116| = 0.113944 <= ln1.5 = 0.405465 (no SUSPECTED_UNADJUSTED_SPLIT); n=26 >= 2k+2=8 (no INSUFFICIENT_BARS); tA=0 with 25 later bars and the duplicate ATH 10 bars before the end (no ATH_TOO_RECENT); all prices > 0 and all rows complete (no INVALID_PRICE / INVALID_INPUT).
Consequently NO_VALID_SECOND_ANCHOR is reached here on the ENVELOPE test alone — never on an absence of pivots — which is precisely the trigger §18 now states.

pivot_analysis.note: Recorded as descriptive metadata only; it has NO bearing on the outcome (§5, D-TL-03, HD-11). Whatever the k=3 pivot set is, candidacy is over all 24 later lower highs and all 24 are pierced by the t=15 tying high. Reporting NO_VALID_SECOND_ANCHOR here would be identical under any k, including k=1.

geometry_check.notes: Hand-verifiable (26 bars). Synthetic OHLCV convention: open = high-2, low = high-3, close = high-1, volume = 900000-1000*t; bars t=0 and t=15 are identical OHLC rows (128.00, 130.00, 127.00, 129.00), which is the double top. Added under Issue #16 (2026-07-25) to supply the genuinely reachable NO_VALID_SECOND_ANCHOR case after HD-11 made the previous 'monotonic decline / no qualifying pivot' trigger unreachable (see the corrected GX-08). It introduces NO new rule: candidacy (§6), domination (§8/D-TL-05), the equal-ATH tie (§4/D-TL-02) and the equal-high-within-eps treatment (GX-12) are all applied exactly as already approved.
